name: Maple-Salted Hydration Water (Clean ORS)
whyItWorks: Uses sodium-glucose co-transport to pull water into the bloodstream without artificial sweeteners (sucralose/sorbitol) or citrus extracts that trigger osmotic diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Mix 16 oz cold water + 1 tbsp pure maple syrup + 1/8 to 1/4 tsp sea salt.
